column2: and no one can look at it
column3: Inconsistent with CR 406.3 and the other rulings on a player once allowed to look at a face-down exiled card (ruling 2024-02-02; work item ruling-conflicts-6, conclusion D; set aside by the user's decision of Nov 12, work item user-decisions-nov12, Part C: "I agree that the headliner scarlett ruling is incorrect, and we should be able to look at the cards."): only the look half is set aside, its "you can't look at" and "no one can look at it"; CR 406.3 ("once a player is allowed to look at a card exiled face down, that player may continue to look at that card until it leaves the exile zone or is part of a pile of cards that are shuffled, even if the instruction allowing the player to do so no longer applies") has read so in substance since the CR effective 2013-02-01, and Colfenor's Plans 2013-04-15 ("you can continue to look at cards exiled by it, but you can no longer play them"), Bane Alley Broker 2013-01-24, Grimoire Thief 2013-07-01, Kheru Mind-Eater 2017-08-25, Ugin, the Ineffable 2019-05-03, The Dragon-Kami Reborn 2022-02-18 and Hoarding Broodlord 2023-04-14 keep the look; the play half ("can't ... play the card ... It remains face down in exile") agrees with CR 514.2 and 611.2a and stays cited (tests/cards/permission_scopes.rs, headliner_scarlett_card_cant_be_played_after_that_turn); the engine keeps the look (kaya_emblem_casts_a_legendary_card_headliner_scarlett_exiled_on_an_earlier_turn); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
